text: In several independent discussions, people say that a work tote or shoulder bag loaded with a laptop becomes too heavy, and several describe shoulder or back pain from it.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0001 using only laptop-confirmed evidence. Reddit commenters who chose to post; not a share of tote owners.

text: Shoulder or back strain from a heavy work bag or tote, in several cases one carrying a laptop, is a reason some people give for switching to a backpack.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0002. Stated reasons; not all cases involve a laptop; other factors may contribute.

text: Several people who switched from a tote to a backpack for comfort describe the backpack as less attractive or juvenile-looking; one says she would still choose a tote if she could, while others accept the trade.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0003. How switchers talk about the trade-off; no frequency and no repurchase data.

text: Some people split their carry instead of using one bag: a backpack on heavy days and a small bag on light days, or two bags carried together, for load, access or convenience.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0004. Workarounds described by commenters; motives differ; not a measure of how common.

text: Some shoppers check how heavy a bag is when empty, and several reject or regret bags that are heavy before anything is put in them, including leather and structured bags.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0005. Covers totes and backpacks; others say the contents, not the bag, are the problem.

text: In work-bag and laptop-bag threads, some people say they do not want a bag that looks like a school bag or hiking gear, and some reject Longchamp-style nylon totes for looking cheap or lacking structure.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0006. Stated preferences about appearance from three threads; no purchase data.

text: Several commenters expect PU or vegan leather to peel or wear out with use, while one owner reports a microfiber vegan bag with no cracking or peeling after about four years.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0007. Beliefs plus one long-term owner report; one source is about jackets; nothing about the Lévant material.

text: One commenter bought a vegan-leather jacket only because it was cheap on sale, after vegan leather had peeled for them; another shopper ruled out a vegan-leather work tote as too pricey for vegan leather.
scope_limits: Replaces C-0008 (downgraded): two individual decisions, one about a jacket; the tote case does not name peeling as the reason.

text: Nordace backpack owners in several threads report zipper, strap or fabric failures; the timings they give range from under a month to a little over two years.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0009. Nordace backpacks, not the Lévant tote; self-selected complaint threads; some reports give no timing.

text: Negative Nordace reviews and the brand's public replies on Reddit led several would-be buyers to say they will not buy or will hold off; these are stated intentions, and the reply-driven ones cluster in two threads.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0011. Stated or implied intentions, one reported second-hand; not verified non-purchases.

text: Two buyers describe Nordace offering a partial refund instead of a free return, with a return to Hong Kong at the buyer's cost as the alternative.
scope_limits: Replaces C-0013 (downgraded): two individual accounts; policies may have changed; other buyers report free replacements.

text: A few commenters cite heavy ad retargeting or a sale countdown that reset as reasons they became suspicious of Nordace.
scope_limits: Replaces C-0014 (downgraded): individual accounts of suspicion, not proven misconduct.
